identifiers.description: The identifiers to erase. At least one is required, and a single request accepts at most 1000.

client_reference.description: Optional caller-supplied reference echoed back on the job. It is also the idempotency key: two identical requests that set the same reference within 24 hours resolve to the same job. Requests that omit it are not deduplicated.

value.description: The identifier value. Email values are normalized and matched case-insensitively; `external_id` values are trimmed and lowercased at intake.

variable.description: Name of the stored variable to match against `value`. Required only when `type` is `variable_match`; leave null for all other types.

DeletionIdentifier.description: A single reference to the end user(s) whose data should be erased.
DeletionIdentifier.title: DeletionIdentifier

DeletionIdentifierType.description: The kind of identifier supplied. `variable_match` selects every end user whose stored variable equals the value.
DeletionIdentifierType.title: DeletionIdentifierType
